newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rate quotes sharply higher on call.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rate quotes sharply higher on call.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted sharply higher Tuesday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session in reaction to grain shippers' demand for freight before ice clogs the rivers, grain and barge sources said.
Two barges traded Tuesday versus one Monday.
- Two barges traded, this week, Illinois River, at 205 percent of tariff - up 60 percentage points from Friday offer.
- Two barges, Mississippi (St Louis), next week, no bid, offered 130 percent - up 27-1/2 points from bid.
- Two barges, next week, Illinois, no bid, offered 220 percent - up 45 points.
- Two barges, one each week of Dec 22 and 29, Illinois, no bid, offered 220 percent - up 40 points.
- Four barges, one each week of January, Mississippi (St Louis), bid 112-1/2 percent - up 15 points and offered 120 - up five.
- Eight barges, two each week of January, lower Ohio, bid 125 percent - up 10 points, no offer.
- Eight barges, two each week of February, Mississippi (Osceola through Cairo), no bid, offered 105 percent - up 7-1/2 from similar offer.
